name: 159. Azure response annotation fidelity (provider response fixture)
description: Local fixture regression like folder 154: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the isolated gateway. The fixture answers model azure-filtered with Azure prompt_filter_results and per-choice content_filter_results; the gateway must return both.

item.name: 159.1 azure upstream content-filter annotations survive the gateway (azure content filters)

exec: pm.test('prompt_filter_results is preserved', function () { pm.expect(j.prompt_filter_results, 'dropped: ' + pm.response.text().slice(0, 500)).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.prompt_filter_results[0].content_filter_results.hate.severity).to.equal('safe'); });

pm.test('per-choice content_filter_results is preserved', function () { pm.expect(j.choices[0].content_filter_results, 'dropped: ' + pm.response.text().slice(0, 500)).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(j.choices[0].content_filter_results.violence.severity).to.equal('safe'); });
